name: Sealbook
description: Save the page you are on as a sealed bookmark in your Sealbook vault.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'
